strings.subtitle: — Pakkakkasa File —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Tarik dé' naulle. Paké tombol ri yawa.
strings.shred_button: K A K K A S A
strings.ssd_warning: Pappé! Ri SSD, cara ro dé' namjami pakkakkasa polana TRIM. Program ro namung untu HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
File "{name}" ka ritimpo sibawa ripakkasa.

Lanjut?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS aliran data alternatif (ADS) dé' napproses.
• Jurnal USN dé' nappabersé.
• Salinan bayangan sibawa sinkronisasi awan
  (OneDrive sibawa maréga) dé' nakenné.
strings.status_full: Isinna ripapparé sininna nol. Dé' naulle ribali — alat namung mancéng nol.
strings.status_fast: Koppé, buntut sibawa 4 MB garis ripapparé. Sésana dé' nakenné, tapi polana rongga, file dé' naulle ribali sininna. Paké mode FULL untu dokumen rahasia.
strings.status_empty: File kosong, dé' paralu ripapparé. Ripakkasa.
strings.error_permission: Dé' naulle monro ri file. Mungkin tabukka ri program maréga. Tuttu sibawa cuba masé.
strings.error_not_found: File dé' naullé. Mungkin alé ripakkasa.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyaé laleng simbolis. Laleng dé' naulle ripakkasa — file tujuan tettek.
strings.error_reparse: Iyaé file samantara (OneDrive sibawa maréga). Datané ri awan, dé' ri disk — dé' ada nan ka ripakkasa.
strings.error_not_file: Iyaé tania file (folder iyarega maréga). Tarik file.
strings.error_hardlinks: File ro mappunnai laleng kare maréga ({n} sininna). Laleng kare dé' mappunnai laleng utama — sininna ase pada. Ri pakkakkasa laleng ro, data ka ripapparé sibawa ripandé ri 32 byte, tapi naulle ribukka ri laleng maréga. Pakkasa sininna laleng riyolo.
strings.error_compressed:
File rikompres, rienkripsi iyarega jarang. Timpo nol dé' namjami pakkakkasa data lamo, polana NTFS mappanreng cara maréga.

Buatta atribut: klik kanang → Properti → Lanjut → buatta "Kompres" sibawa/iyearega "Enkripsi". Passé ro paké SHREDDER masé.
